title: Geo residency routing and priority playbook for enterprise intake
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operational playbook and decision workflow for ingesting enterprise requests about region availability and data residency constraints. The goal is to standardize intake, scoring, routing to SRE/Capacity/Legal, and to provide clear customer commitments (fallthrough policy and expected timelines). This ticket focuses on the product/process artifacts and handoffs rather than implementation of new infra.
acceptance_criteria: A single-page intake template used by Support and AE to capture required info (data residency, regulatory citations, failover SLA)
A prioritized scoring rubric (latency, revenue ARR, legal risk, infra cost, strategic value) with numeric thresholds
Clear routing rules: when to auto-approve, when to escalate to Legal/Security, when to route to Capacity for dedicated procurement
Handback text templates for sales/support for the 3 common outcomes: available/short-term, available/with-commit, not-viable and recommended fallback
Documented SLA expectations and CRL (customer-ready language) for a 'region onboarding' timeline
A follow-up task list for Eng/SRE with required artifacts to estimate work (capacity estimate, deployment plan, cost delta)
Playbook reviewed and signed off by Legal (Ksenia Ivanov), Security (Jordan Lee), and SRE lead (Priya Raman)
notes: Background: customers increasingly request geo-residency or local failover in APAC/EU. Sales needs repeatable answers and SLAs to close enterprise deals.
We must avoid ad-hoc promises that create unscoped engineering work or legal exposure.
This playbook should be usable by AE/Support without deep product knowledge and should reduce average triage time from 7 days to 48 hours.
tasks: Design scoring rubric and threshold table
Define routing automations in Zendesk/Support workflow
Create handback email/case templates for three outcomes
Run 2 pilot intakes with Sales and Support and iterate
Hold sign-off meeting with Legal, Security, SRE
Publish playbook in Confluence and announce in GTM Slack channel
